name: Icon rail
summary: An unlabelled rail of 50-60px carries the brand mark at the top and 15-18px outline icons on a 34-49px pitch; groups are split by 20px hairlines, utilities sit at the bottom.

numbers.active: icon colour alone, or a full-bleed 50px band at a 2% tint, or a 1px accent bar on the rail's border
numbers.utilities: pushed to the bottom after a gap of about 200px

blueprint: An unlabelled rail of 50-60px carries the brand mark at the top and 15-18px outline icons on a 34-49px pitch; groups are split by 20px hairlines, utilities sit at the bottom. The rail sits on the page ground with a 1px edge, or is white with a faint 4px shadow on a grey ground. It saves about 180px of width against a labelled sidebar, so it suits products with few destinations and screens that need the width. Icons need tooltips and an accessible name.
phone: The rail becomes a bottom bar with the same four or five icons, each with a short label under it.

name: No sidebar
summary: A 46-48px top bar on the page ground over a centred 1088-1208px column; the logo sits exactly on the column's left edge and the bar's right cluster ends near its right edge, so header and content share one column.

numbers.topBar: 46-48px on the page ground, no border

blueprint: A 46-48px top bar on the page ground over a centred 1088-1208px column; the logo sits exactly on the column's left edge and the bar's right cluster ends near its right edge, so header and content share one column. Three to five text links, a 36px search, the account. Use it for generated reports, viewers and products with few destinations; with a sticky bar on the same ground, give it a 1px rule when content scrolls under it (the studied bar without one sliced content off).
phone: The bar keeps the logo, a search icon and a menu button; the links move into the menu sheet. The column becomes the full width with 16px margins.

name: Open plane
summary: The labelled sidebar sits on the page ground with nothing or one hairline between it and the canvas; there is no top bar, and the page header and cards sit straight on the ground about 32-36px from the top.

numbers.sidebarWidth: 230-256 (230, 240, 256 in the study; 280 and 292 with a built-in icon rail)
numbers.separation: none, or one 1px hairline; the sidebar sits on the page ground or within 1-2% of it
numbers.activeItem: neutral grey pill, radius 6-12, inset 8-12px from the sidebar edges (#e9e9e9-#ededed)
numbers.canvas: fluid with a 24-64px gutter, or a centred 1100px column

blueprint: The labelled sidebar sits on the page ground with nothing or one hairline between it and the canvas; there is no top bar, and the page header and cards sit straight on the ground about 32-36px from the top. Workspace or account switcher at the top of the sidebar, primary nav on a 34px pitch, groups under 12-13px sentence-case grey labels with 22-56px of air above, utilities and the user row pushed to the bottom. Cards are white on the off-white ground (or the sidebar is white with a 1px border on a #f9fafb canvas). The canvas is fluid with one gutter value, or a centred column for personal homes.
phone: The sidebar folds into a 48px top bar holding the screen's name, a menu button that opens a full-screen sheet with the nav and the switcher, and at most one action. Content takes the full width with 16px margins.

name: Ruled T-frame
summary: A 210-240px sidebar and a 64px top bar share one ground, divided only by 1px rules.

numbers.switcher: at the top bar's right end, behind a full-height 1px divider
numbers.contentGutter: 29px from the sidebar rule and the window edge

blueprint: A 210-240px sidebar and a 64px top bar share one ground, divided only by 1px rules. The workspace or community switcher sits at the right end of the top bar behind a full-height divider; the sidebar holds the wordmark and the nav on a 34px pitch with sentence-case group labels. On dark, the active item is its label going from #bbb to #fff. The top bar must carry something real (search, the back link and object name, the switcher): two studied screens left about 1070px of it blank and were flagged.
phone: The top bar stays at 48-56px with the switcher reduced to its mark; the sidebar becomes a full-screen menu sheet or a bottom bar of four or five destinations.

name: Tinted frame, white sheet
summary: Sidebar and top bar share one tinted ground with no rule between them, forming an L; the page lives on a white sheet.

numbers.sheetInset: 8px from the window's right and bottom edges (12 and 16 once each)
numbers.topBar: 48px on the chrome ground with no rule; search 548x32 centred on the window with a shortcut hint
numbers.floatingVariant: both panels inset 12px with a 12px gutter, radius 10

blueprint: Sidebar and top bar share one tinted ground with no rule between them, forming an L; the page lives on a white sheet. Variant one: the sheet butts against the sidebar and the top bar and is inset 8px from the right and bottom edges, 16px radius, 1px edge. Variant two: a flush L-frame with no inset, the frame marked by one rule. Variant three: sidebar and content are two floating panels inset 12px from every edge with a 12px gutter. The top bar, when present, is 48px and holds a centred search, the account button and a help or AI icon. Inside the sheet the content has 24px padding and starts with the breadcrumb or title row.
phone: The frame disappears: the sheet becomes the screen, with a 48px top bar (menu button, title, one action) on the chrome tint. The search moves into the menu sheet or behind an icon.
